name: Jubilee

abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Jubilee için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Princess of Pyrotechnics
Each time one of Jubilee's personal Debuffs expires on the Opponent, deal a burst of [1,754.78 - 3,480] Energy Damage.
Each time the Opponent Purifies any Debuff, deal a burst of [2,851.51 - 5,655] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Mutation - Always Active
content: Jubilee's energy plasmoids cause her Basic Attacks to deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
+[1,500] Energy Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Fireworks -
content: Jubilee can rotate through Orange, Pink and Blue Fireworks. Throwing Light and Medium Attacks rotates Fireworks.
If a Firework Surge is selected in the pre-fight screen, at the start of the fight, gain a Firework Surge, preventing Jubilee from rotating Fireworks for 16 second(s).
While Firework Surge is active, gain bonus effects when landing a hit or striking into a block, based on the active Firework:
Orange: Deal 55% of hit damage as a burst of Energy Damage.
Pink: Opponents suffer -30% Defensive Combat Power Rate.
Blue: Opponents suffer -50% Defensive Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: While Firework Surge is not active, being struck, landing a hit or striking into the block has a 50% chance to apply a Prowess Buff, increasing Special Attack Damage by 12.5% until the end of the next Special Attack. Max 12 stack(s).
When intercepting the Opponent's Dash Attack, this chance is increased to 100%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: When charging a Heavy Attack while a Firework Surge is active, remove the Firework Surge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Firework Surge lasting 6 second(s).
When the last hit lands or strikes into the block, apply the effects of the active Firework, increasing the duration by 1 second(s) for each Prowess Effect:
Orange: Inflict a Shock Debuff and consume all Damaging Debuffs on Jubilee. For each Damaging Debuff consumed, inflict another Shock Debuff, dealing [3,915] Energy Damage over 9 second(s).
Pink: Inflict a Taunt Debuff for 9 seconds.
Blue: Inflict a Slow Debuff, lasting 9 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a Firework Surge lasting 19 second(s).
When the last hit lands or strikes into the block, apply the effects of the active Firework:
Orange: Inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [7,612.5] Energy Damage over 22 second(s). This also removes the target's Perfect Block Chance and reduces their Block Proficiency by 50%.
Pink: Inflict a Suppression Debuff, reducing Combat Power Rate by 25% for 22 second(s).
Blue: Inflict a Concussion Debuff, reducing the Opponent's Ability Accuracy by 25% for 22 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, gain a Firework Surge lasting 16 second(s).
Consume up to 12 Prowess Buffs and gain an indefinite Prowess Passive for each Prowess that was consumed, increasing Special Attack Damage by 12.5%. Max 12 stack(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Princess of Pyrotechnics
content: Each time one of Jubilee's personal Debuffs expires on the Opponent, deal a burst of [1,754.78 - 3,480] Energy Damage.
Each time the Opponent Purifies any Debuff, deal a burst of [2,851.51 - 5,655] Energy Damage.
